name: list_my_businesses
description: The businesses you're a member of on bookanything: slug, name, your role there, its timezone and today's date there, and whether its owner lets you use AI apps there. Pass the slug as `business` to the other tools (it may be left out when there is only one).
title: List my businesses

name: confirm_action
description: Carries out a proposal you made (a booking, move, cancellation, blocked time, …) exactly as proposed, when its status is awaiting_confirmation. Only call it after showing the proposal to the member and getting their clear agreement. A proposal awaiting_approval doesn't go ahead this way: the member approves it on bookanything at its approvalUrl. Confirming twice returns the first result. A proposal can't be confirmed after it expires or if the time was taken meanwhile.
title: Confirm a proposal

name: cancel_action
description: Drops a proposal the member doesn't want, so it can't be confirmed later. Nothing changes.
title: Drop a proposal

name: get_proposal
description: Where a proposal you made stands: awaiting_approval (the member hasn't approved it on bookanything yet; approvalUrl is the link to give them), awaiting_confirmation, confirmed (with what was done), rejected, expired or failed. Use it after the member says they've approved or declined it.
title: Check a proposal

name: approve_bookings

business.description: The business: its slug or id from list_my_businesses. May be left out when you belong to just one business.

description: Proposes approving booking requests (status pending_approval; up to 20): each customer is emailed that they're booked. Nothing is approved until the user confirms. find_bookings with status pending_approval lists them. Returns a proposal: nothing changes until the member approves it on bookanything (its approvalUrl) or, for a change their business lets apps make, you call confirm_action with its id.
title: Approve bookings

name: block_time

business.description: The business: its slug or id from list_my_businesses. May be left out when you belong to just one business.

startTime.description: HH:mm, or null for the whole day

endTime.description: HH:mm, or null for the whole day

reason.description: Short note, e.g. Dentist, or null

description: Proposes blocking time for one resource on one date (time off, a meeting, maintenance): no new bookings can be made then. Existing bookings are listed and stay booked. Staff can only block their own time. Nothing changes until confirmed. Returns a proposal: nothing changes until the member approves it on bookanything (its approvalUrl) or, for a change their business lets apps make, you call confirm_action with its id.
title: Block time

name: business_overview

business.description: The business: its slug or id from list_my_businesses. May be left out when you belong to just one business.

description: Today's bookings, the next 7 days, bookings and revenue in the last 30 days, pending approvals and the setup checklist. Call this for "how are we doing", "what needs my attention" or a daily summary. Staff get their own numbers and no revenue.
title: Business overview

name: cancel_bookings

business.description: The business: its slug or id from list_my_businesses. May be left out when you belong to just one business.

reason.description: Reason shown to the customer, or null

refund.description: How much of any payment to refund

notifyCustomer.description: Email each customer about the cancellation

description: Proposes cancelling one or more bookings (up to 20), showing each booking and the refund it would get; nothing is cancelled until the user confirms. refund: policy (the business's rules: a business cancellation refunds in full), full or none. Returns a proposal: nothing changes until the member approves it on bookanything (its approvalUrl) or, for a change their business lets apps make, you call confirm_action with its id.
title: Cancel bookings

name: check_availability

business.description: The business: its slug or id from list_my_businesses. May be left out when you belong to just one business.

resourceId.description: Only times with this resource (id from list_resources), or null for anyone suitable

optionId.description: Service option id when the service has options, else null

description: Finds free start times for a service (and optionally one resource) over up to 7 days. Call this before proposing a new booking or a reschedule, and to answer "when is X free". Times with a deal say so (bookings there get it automatically). Staff see their own calendar only.
title: Check availability

name: close_date

business.description: The business: its slug or id from list_my_businesses. May be left out when you belong to just one business.

reason.description: Shown to the team, e.g. Bank holiday, or null

description: Proposes closing the whole business for one date (bank holiday, training day): nobody can book that day. Every existing booking that day is listed and stays booked (cancel them separately if asked). Nothing changes until confirmed. Admins and owners only. Returns a proposal: nothing changes until the member approves it on bookanything (its approvalUrl) or, for a change their business lets apps make, you call confirm_action with its id.
title: Close date

name: create_booking

business.description: The business: its slug or id from list_my_businesses. May be left out when you belong to just one business.

optionId.description: Option id when the service has options, else null

start.description: Start time: a start value from check_availability (ISO-8601 with offset)

resourceIds.description: Specific resources to book, or null to pick suitable ones

customerId.description: Existing customer id from find_customers, or null with newCustomer

notifyCustomer.description: Email the customer a confirmation (true unless the user says otherwise)

internalNotes.description: A note for the team, or null

description: Proposes a new booking; nothing is booked until the user confirms. Check the time with check_availability first and use one of its start values. Use an existing customer's id when find_customers finds them, otherwise give newCustomer. paymentMode: at_venue unless the user wants a payment link (collect_online) or it is free (none). Returns a proposal: nothing changes until the member approves it on bookanything (its approvalUrl) or, for a change their business lets apps make, you call confirm_action with its id.
title: Create booking

name: create_customer

business.description: The business: its slug or id from list_my_businesses. May be left out when you belong to just one business.

notes.description: Notes for the team, or null

description: Proposes adding a customer record (for someone who books by phone or in person). Check find_customers first: an email can only belong to one customer. Nothing is added until the user confirms. Returns a proposal: nothing changes until the member approves it on bookanything (its approvalUrl) or, for a change their business lets apps make, you call confirm_action with its id.
title: Create customer

name: decline_booking

business.description: The business: its slug or id from list_my_businesses. May be left out when you belong to just one business.

reason.description: Reason shown to the customer, or null

description: Proposes declining a booking request (status pending_approval): the customer is emailed, with the reason if given, and anything paid is refunded in full. Nothing happens until the user confirms. Returns a proposal: nothing changes until the member approves it on bookanything (its approvalUrl) or, for a change their business lets apps make, you call confirm_action with its id.
title: Decline booking

name: find_bookings

business.description: The business: its slug or id from list_my_businesses. May be left out when you belong to just one business.

query.description: Customer name, email, phone or booking reference (e.g. BA-7K3F9Q); null for any

status.description: Only this status; null for all except expired

customerId.description: Only this customer's bookings (an id from find_customers)

description: Searches bookings by customer name, email, phone or booking reference, status and date range. Call this to find a specific booking before rescheduling, cancelling or sending a payment link. Without dates it searches 90 days back to 180 days ahead.
title: Find bookings

name: find_customers

business.description: The business: its slug or id from list_my_businesses. May be left out when you belong to just one business.

query.description: Part of a name, email address or phone number

description: Finds customers by name, email or phone. Call this to get a customer's id before booking them in or listing their bookings. Staff see customers who have booked with them (or have no bookings yet).
title: Find customers

name: get_booking

business.description: The business: its slug or id from list_my_businesses. May be left out when you belong to just one business.

description: One booking in full: its details, payments (charges, refunds, paid at the venue) and history (who made, moved, approved or cancelled it, and when). Find the id with find_bookings or get_schedule.
title: Get booking

name: get_customer

business.description: The business: its slug or id from list_my_businesses. May be left out when you belong to just one business.

description: One customer in full: contact details, notes and their bookings here, newest first. Find the id with find_customers.
title: Get customer

name: get_policies

business.description: The business: its slug or id from list_my_businesses. May be left out when you belong to just one business.

description: The booking policies (notice, how far ahead, cancellation window and late refund, holds) and upcoming whole-business closures. Call this for questions about cancellations, refunds, notice or closed days.
title: Get policies

name: get_schedule

business.description: The business: its slug or id from list_my_businesses. May be left out when you belong to just one business.

date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD in the business timezone (list_my_businesses gives today's date there)

days.description: Number of days from date, 1 to 7

resourceId.description: Only this resource's bookings (an id from list_resources), or null for all

description: Lists the bookings on the schedule for one or more days (not cancelled ones). Call this for questions like "what's on today", "who is in tomorrow", "am I busy on Friday" or before suggesting changes to a day. Staff only see their own calendar. Rows are short (no contact details or form answers: find_bookings has those) and stop at 60 bookings (truncated: ask for fewer days or one resource).
title: Get schedule

name: get_stats

business.description: The business: its slug or id from list_my_businesses. May be left out when you belong to just one business.

description: Business statistics for a date range (up to 92 days): bookings, cancellations, no-shows, revenue, refunds, new customers, top services and resource utilisation. Call this for questions about performance, busiest services or trends. Admins and owners only.
title: Get stats

name: list_deals

business.description: The business: its slug or id from list_my_businesses. May be left out when you belong to just one business.

description: The business's deals: what each discounts and when, whether it's active or paused, and how many bookings used it. Admins and owners only.
title: List deals

name: list_resources

business.description: The business: its slug or id from list_my_businesses. May be left out when you belong to just one business.

description: Lists the bookable resources (people, rooms, equipment) with ids and weekly opening hours. Call this to find a resource id, or before blocking time or changing opening hours. Staff see only their own resources.
title: List resources

name: list_services

business.description: The business: its slug or id from list_my_businesses. May be left out when you belong to just one business.

title: List services
